tagline: One room, one speaker, everyone's music: a shared queue that takes turns.
host_intro: Hosts and the admin sign in with Spotify. Joining a session needs no sign-in.
host_status_approved: You may host sessions on your own device.
host_status_pending: Waiting for the admin to approve you as a host.
admin_only: Only the admin may do this.
admin_sign_in_required: Sign in as the admin first.
admin_sign_in_intro: Sign in with the admin's Spotify account to manage the room account and hosts.
admin_room_intro: The Spotify account that plays on the room's speaker. Anyone may start a session on it.
admin_room_hint: Spotify asks which account to connect: choose “Not you?” and sign in with the room account. It needs Premium and a place on the Spotify app's allowlist.
admin_hosts_intro: Accounts that signed in here. Approved hosts may start sessions on their own device.
admin_hosts_none: Nobody else has signed in yet.
admin_remove_hint: Removing deletes the stored tokens; the account can sign in again.
token_status_revoked: Revoked by Spotify: sign in again
auth_state_mismatch: The sign-in could not be verified. Please start it again.
auth_cancelled: The sign-in at Spotify was cancelled.
auth_not_allowlisted: Spotify refused this account. It has to be added to the allowlist of the Spotify app (User Management in the developer dashboard).
auth_failed: Spotify could not be reached. Please try again.
auth_room_is_host: This account is the admin or an approved host, so it cannot be the room account. In Spotify's dialog, choose “Not you?” and sign in with the room account.
auth_is_room_account: This is the room account. It is connected on the admin page and does not sign in here. In Spotify's dialog, choose “Not you?” and sign in with your own account.
error_internal: Something went wrong. Please try again.
